notes.title: Wishlist Our Upcoming Game!
notes.notes:
The story has been completely re-written from start to finish with a brand new script. There's tons of new dialogue choices, to allow for greater immersion into your journey as The Savior. There's a brand new UI, and quality of life changes as well! It's a brand new experience, made as a love letter to those who enjoyed the original, and to those who helped make it happen! Add it to your wishlist today so you can get notified when it releases! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2701070/MajorMinor_20_ReVision/

Also, feel free to join the Discord!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41495357/293a7f42fb9a96a61d6ad8e6078c95e9aca56e05.png[/img]

notes.title: Nominate Komorebi Today!
notes.notes:
Hey there!

The Steam Awards are open for nominations! I know this game and the dev team are relatively small-time, but I've definitely seen the fandom accomplish incredible things over the years. If we band together, then anything is possible. I'd be honored if you considered nominating Komorebi for Outstanding Story-Rich Game. I truly hope you enjoyed your time in Toronto, and enjoyed stepping into Delta's shoes.

Thanks so much!

If you enjoyed your journey, consider diving into the community over on the Discord:
[url=https://www.discord.gg/klace]https://www.discord.gg/klace
[/url]
Klace

notes.title: Komorebi - Releasing July 27th
notes.notes:
That's right!

Komorebi will be available for PC on July 27th @ 10AM PT, right here on Steam!

Please consider [b]adding the game to your wishlist[/b] for a release notification!

The tie-in pop album is also coming to Spotify and Bandcamp on July 21st!

Full speed ahead, we're almost at Komorebi month!

See you all then! <3

Klace
